name: vis-timeline
description: Render interactive timelines in notes. Supports BCE/CE historical dates, YAML authoring, and row groups with nesting.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/core && node esbuild.config.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
